notes:
Context: building a GitHub-style PR review assistant integrated into their internal Bitbucket/GitHub flow. Primary buyer: Platform/Tools team; end-users are engineering squads. Focus: fast inline diff summaries, one-click suggested comments, and reranking of bot comments by confidence.

Key technical asks (from calls):
- Low-latency streaming for inline suggestions (target: 80-120ms first-byte for single-line suggestions; 200-400ms for multi-line)
- Model/version pinning per workspace and fallback routing if pinned model unavailable
- Deterministic reranking: ability to provide n suggestions and run reranker tuned by team quality signals
- Embedding index for historical diffs + semantic search for similar past PRs (approx 50M diff tokens)
- Token cost sensitivity: want to evaluate batching and prefix caching to reduce hosted costs

Security & compliance:
- Must support SSO (SAML + SCIM) and audit logs for generated content and model calls
- KMS integration required for any dedicated/private keys; retention controls for logs
- Data residency: prefer NA first, EU later for distributed teams

Quotes / rep notes:
- "If we can't get near-realtime suggestions in the editor, adoption won't happen." — Head of Developer Productivity
- SE: "Need explicit model pinning and rollback mechanics for staged rollouts across org units."

Evaluation criteria (what will make them buy):
- End-to-end latency for inline suggestions in VSCode and web review UI
- Clear cost model and measurable cost-savings from batching/caching
- Easy integration with existing CI and code review webhooks
- Security checklist passed: SOC2 + KMS + SSO

Communication style in CRM: shorthand, action items. Bring infra diagram, latency test plan, and sample model pinning policy to next call.
